name: Aprosuchus
sum: Aprosuchus is a small atoposaurid from the Maastrichtian Pui Beds of the Hateg Basin, Romania.
wsnote: Described as small-bodied; no length is given.
holotype: UBB V.562/1, an incomplete three-dimensional skull with closely associated mandibles, from the Hateg Basin, Romania.
material: The holotype and a referred set of cervical vertebrae (UBB V.562/2).
biology: Its teeth show at least four morphotypes (pseudocaniniform, pseudoziphodont lanceolate, ziphodont lanceolate and low-crowned), per English Wikipedia; no more on diet.
author: Venczel and Codrea 2019

sources.text: M. Venczel and V. A. Codrea. 2019. A new Theriosuchus-like crocodyliform from the Maastrichtian of Romania. Cretaceous Research 100:24-38
